issue.title: [Bug]: New loopback_ip var in test_acl.py not populated correctly if rand_selected_dut is supervisor on T2

failure.body:
### Issue Description
Loopback IP variable (introduced in #15619) in `test_acl.py` doesn't get populated properly when supervisor is chosen through `rand_selected_dut` as supervisor doesn't have a loopback ip in mg_facts. This causes errors when applying `loopback_ip` to .j2 templates.

**Additionally we know this to not happen if a LC is chosen**

### Results you see
loopback_ip is not populated when a supervisor is chosen
```
conftest.set_rand_one_dut_hostname       L0499 INFO   | Randomly select dut sonic1-sup for testing
...
test_acl.acl_table                       L0595 INFO   | Generated ACL table configuration:
{'loopback_ip': None,
 ...}
```

This causes failures when trying to apply `loopback_ip` to .j2 templates

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/openconfig_acl.py", line 1662, in _set_destination_ip_address
```

### Results you expected to see
Supervisor shouldn't be chosen as random DUT if loopback ip is needed OR loopback ip should have a default

generic

resolution.title: [acl/test_acl.py] Ensure frontend dut is used for T2 in ACL testing
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #17048

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] New Test case
    - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms
- [ ] Test case improvement

### Back port request
- [ ] 202012
- [ ] 202205
- [ ] 202305
- [ ] 202311
- [ ] 202405
- [ ] 202411

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Previously ACL test change picks up loopback ip from `rand_selected_dut`, on T2 devices supervisor card doesn't have a loopback ip causing errors
#### How did you do it?
Use `rand_selected_front_end_dut` instead of `rand_selected_dut` for T2
#### How did you verify/test it?
Ran 61 iterations of basic ACL test to make sure it passes on T2 device
Additionally:
T0: [Test plan 67daa46be946313de56c8bf2: ACL changes regression test T0 - Elastictest (elastictest.org)](https://elastictest.org/scheduler/testplan/67daa46be946313de56c8bf2)
